content.short: Bucket Protocol is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless decentralized cdps within the Web3 ecosystem on Sui.
content.description: Lending protocol on Sui minting BUCK stablecoin. By leveraging the underlying security and performance of the Sui network(s), Bucket Protocol aims to deliver a robust and scalable solution for its users. The project offers a suite of decentralized tools tailored for decentralized cdps, ensuring transparent and trustless operations. As the Web3 landscape continues to evolve, Bucket Protocol is positioning itself as a core infrastructure component to empower builders and end-users alike, bridging the gap between traditional architectures and decentralized networks.
